text.p: LaserMaster Technologies Inc's patent infringement claims against Sentinel Imagining were dismissed by a U.S. District Court in Minnesota, Sentinel Imaging said.
LaserMaster filed its claims in October 1995.

According to Sentinel, the ruling puts LaserMaster's case in "a collapsed state." It affirms an earlier magistrate report that the Sentinel Color Key System does not infringe on LaserMaster's U.S. patent which applies to the "Big Ink" component on the system, Sentinel said.
LaserMaster officials were not available to comment.
Later in the day a LasterMaster spokesman confirmed that the "Big Ink" component claim was dismissed.

He added, however, that the claim was only one of seven patent infringement claims LaserMaster made against Sentinel Imaging and that six are still pending against Sentinel, including false advertising and patent infringement.
He said the suit itself will still go to trial in April, as planned.
